The house of Glow & Grace

Beauty that is felt, not just worn

Founded in Lucknow, Glow & Grace brings together two worlds — a curated retail house of authentic cosmetics, and a career studio that places trained beauty professionals with the city's finest salons.

Every product is sourced directly from brand-authorised channels. Every placement is verified, salary-checked and followed up for ninety days.

Our Story

Since 2015 · Lucknow

Two promises, one house

Glow & Grace began as a small counter in Lucknow with a simple belief — that authentic beauty products and honest career opportunities should never be hard to find.

Today we serve over five thousand customers, work with a hundred and fifty partner salons, and have placed more than two hundred trained professionals into full-time beauty careers.
